markets.question: Will Everton FC win against Coventry City FC in the Premier League match scheduled for Nov 6, 2026?
markets.description: This market will settle to the winner at the end of 90 minutes plus stoppage time in the Everton FC vs Coventry City FC Premier League match scheduled for November 6, 2026 at 3:00PM ET (as of the listing of the event's first instrument). If the match is tied following 90 minutes plus stoppage time, the market will settle to Tie. If the match is delayed, postponed, suspended or otherwise rescheduled to a date and time not within two days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from Premier League.
